name: Accora Configura® Bariatric | TIS | Vinyl
shortDescription: Bariatric lift recline chair.
fullDescription: The prices displayed are for non-customised products only. If you require any additional options, p lease complete a Referral Assessment Form, an Assessment Form, and attach them when you click the “Request a Quote” button. Y ou will be contacted by a product specialist o nce we receive your request. Accora Configura® Bariatric brings Configura® technology to bariatric seating. This offers unprecedented adjustability, flexibility and peace of mind for the prescriber. It is also available with a full width alternating air cushion to meet the needs of users at high risk of pressure damage. Tilt-in-space improves pelvic stability and posture, pressure distribution, circulation, makes hoisting easier and reduces the tendency to slip forward in the chair. By maintaining the same angle at the hips (i.e. the same angle between backrest and seat base), and tilting the entire chair back, the user can achieve a relaxed position whilst maintaining pelvic stability. Maintaining the position of the pelvis promotes good sitting and reduces the user’s susceptibility to developing poor posture. As more weight is transferred through the trunk and less through the base, a larger seating footprint is achieved and pressure is distributed over a wider area. This reduces the risk of pressure sores in the sensitive sacral and ischial tuberosity areas. The ability to have the user’s ankles higher than the hips can also aid circulation and reduce fluid build-up in the legs. When hoisting, Tilt-in-Space enables gravity to assist in correct positioning of the user’s pelvis at the back of the chair. The independent legrest enables tilt to be used whilst lowering the legs. Suitable for users with reduced knee flexion or shortened hamstrings. name: Aspire Heel Protectors
shortDescription: Heel offloading device for every client at risk of developing, or who has existing, heel pressure injuries.
fullDescription: Heel ulcers are the most common facility-acquired pressure sores in long-term acute care facilities. Heels are particularly vulnerable to pressure injury due to direct sustained pressure on the heel from prolonged contact with the supporting surface. As a result, much of the pressure from the weight of the foot and lower leg is concentrated on the small area of skin overlying the heel. The Aspire Heel Protector is designed to offload pressure from the bony prominence of the heel area and redistribute it to the larger surface area of the lower leg. Features and Benefits An intelligent leg support zone offloads pressure from the heel and redistributes it to the larger surface area of the lower leg Soft breathable natural cotton fabric outer Cushioning silicone fibre inner promotes airflow for skin microclimate management Seams are located within padding folds to avoid pressure points Adjustable velcro straps offer a snug fit and facilitate one universal size Machine washable Sold as a pair Compliance ARTG 298451 Warranty 12 months

shortDescription: Cura¹ PreAlert Sensor Pad is unique because it gives a true early warning to the caregiver, unlike conventional sensor pads.  As soon as the patient sits
fullDescription: Cura¹ PreAlert Sensor Pad is unique because it gives a true early warning to the caregiver, unlike conventional sensor pads. This way, they can provide the care they need and prevent falls or injuries. In addition, the PreAlert cordless bed pad features a delay zone in the centre to reduce the likelihood of false alarms. Reducing false alarms and providing early alerts when leaving the bed are among the best solutions available. Features and Benefits Provides early warning when a patient or resident sits on the edge of the bed Comes with transmitter | rubber band | clip set Simple operation and maintenance No more cords between monitor and pads Vent holes in the neck reduce the risk of moisture ingress Available standalone (with transmitter) or as a kit. fullDescription: The JAY Union is a versatile, comfortable skin protection and positioning cushion composed of a dynamic fluid and foam layering system, a moisture resistant inner cover, and an antimic robial outer cover. This material combination creates the ultimate sitting surface: it distributes weight for pressure relief and offers maximum comfort. The JAY Flow fluid insert lying beneath the Visco™ foam conforms to each individual’s unique contours for even pressure distribution beneath the pelvis and a reduced risk of skin breakdown. The base of Axiom is constructed with high-IFD polyurethane foam. The cover is constructed with a 4-way stretch, water-resistant, pleated top layer with a skid-resistant bottom panel, and high denier side panels. All elements of the material lead to a long-lasting, comfortable and functional product. Axiom innovative cover is aesthetically pleasing and offers functional benefits for both the client and the caregiver. shortDescription: Foldable, lightweight, portable patient lifter.
fullDescription: The Molift Smart 150 Generation 2 is a foldable, lightweight, and portable patient lifter that is easy to wheel around and transport. It is designed for short-distance transfers, such as between a bed and a chair or into the bathroom. The Generation 2 offers all the benefits of its predecessor with improved features such as a new battery with double the capacity, increasing time between charges, a significant increase in product life expectancy to 15 years, a hoist that moves 30% faster when unloaded, saving time, and wireless Bluetooth connectivity to the Molift Service Tool. This product has been awarded for Design Excellence by the Norwegian Design Council. This Molift Smart 150 Generation 2 patient hoist is ideal for home use and travel, fitting into a car for convenient transportation and storage. When folded, it can even fit into a small hatchback! Due to its low weight, small footprint and unique construction, the Molift Smart 150 is easy to manoeuvre even in narrow spaces. The hoisting range of 195 to 1665 mm provides an excellent maximum hoisting height while remaining very low and allowing lifting from the floor. Its standard 4-point sling bar provides a comfortable lifting position for users, offering ample space around the head to prevent contact with the sling bar or swinging side-to-side. This design promotes a natural, correct seating position for users transitioning between lying and sitting. With its unique design, excellent centre of balance, and small footprint, the Smart 150 is highly manoeuvrable, even in tight spaces. Features and Benefits

name: Novis® AreaCare® Optimum Pressure Surface Mattress
shortDescription: Comfort Level: Soft Patient Risk Category: Low to medium.
fullDescription: The AreaCare® Optimum Pressure Surface is a multi-density foam pressure surface with a castellated memory foam top layer for improved profiling and microclimate airflow. The Mattress’ multi-density foam pressure surface and tapered heel zone offer maximum pressure reduction in a three-layer foam design for higher-risk patients in the Low/Medium risk category. The three-layered zoned design of this pressure surface is ideal for patients with poor mobility or uncertain skin sensitivity. Made from premium materials, each foam layer is made of varying density to maximise the overall redistribution of pressure. The top layer, comprised of memory foam incorporates an immersive castellated design, whilst the slow recovery foam foot zone and tapered heel slope improve ventilation to the surface of the skin and increase offloading for the ulcer-prone heel area. The AreaCare® Optimum Pressure Surface Mattress is part of a comprehensive range of static foam pressure-relieving surfaces designed to maintain skin integrity and help prevent pressure injury through immersion while delivering maximum comfort. The AreaCare Pressure Surface range is tested to global standards to offer optimal fire retardancy and antibacterial protection. fullDescription: Silicone coating lubricates each fibre to reduce friction and shear force while preventing moisture penetration or retention. Ideally suited for geriatric or palliative care. fullDescription: Flex cushion implements a truly adaptable and easy approach for even the hardest-to-solve cushion requirements for users with complex postures. As its name describes, Flex has been designed to fulfil the postural requirements of wheelchair users who present with limited hip flexion. Up-to-date research shows that a considerable number of clients with cerebral palsy at GMFCS level V, present with asymmetric limited hip flexion. This condition must be ruled out or compensated as it has been linked to the development of other conditions like pelvic obliquity, trunk asymmetry, scoliosis, and windswept hip distortion (Ágústsson, A. et al, 2017). Considering a lack of products available that can support clients with symmetric or asymmetric limited hip flexion, and considering the negative impact that this can have on people’s posture and function, we have developed this superior, comfortable, pressure relieving, stable and highly configurable cushion able to address even the most challenging postural requirements. Every Flex comes with an easily configurable strategic positioning base. The innovative and clinical benefits of the pads and wedges allows the prescribing clinician to achieve a result on-the-spot whilst having the peace of mind that its able to change for future unseen posture changes. Flex has a unique cover design which can change its shape. This ensures that once all the adaptations are done to the inner foam unit, the incontinence and outer covers are manipulated for a comfortable fit. Features and Benefits Positioning base primarily accommodates lack of hip flexion up to 20° but due to its innovative positioning base it can support ruling out other associated deformities as pelvic obliquity, windsweeping, hip abduction, hip internal rotation with tight hamstrings and even lack of hip extension. It reaches a maximum speed of 10km/h in just 3 seconds and boasts a theoretical range of 40km. For added comfort, a 45° tilt and electric backrest provide superior pressure relief.
